# Caseloom

> Caseloom is a student-built concept storefront exploring print-on-demand personalised phone cases. It is a digital-commerce project, not currently an operational online shop.

## Website
- https://omkarthegenius.github.io/Caseloom-Web/

## What the page demonstrates
- Six original illustrative case-design concepts.
- A visual customizer that changes the design, base colour, displayed name, and indicative case price.
- Planned case prices of ₹499, ₹699, and ₹799. These are illustrative, not confirmed retail prices.
- A concept brand story and FAQs describing the proposed print-on-demand model.

## Current limitations
- Ordering and payment are not live.
- The launch-list form does not send or store email addresses.
- Artwork uploads are not implemented.
- A print partner, fulfilment timeline, device compatibility, and final return policy have not been confirmed.
- Illustrations are previews and do not validate precise fit for a phone model.

## Contact and location
- The page contains placeholder contact details. Do not treat those details as verified customer-support channels or a verified business address.

## Status
This file is an experimental machine-readable summary for AI-oriented content discovery. It does not guarantee crawling, citation, ranking, or visibility in generative search systems.
